text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The St. Lite Kinen—the race preceding
the Kikuka Sho—is about to start, and
this is where Kitasan
Black's autumn
officially begins.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Trainer! The big race is
3,000
meters long, but first I've only
gotta conquer this
2,200 meter one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll be your trainer's backup, so no
worries!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since Kitasan Black's races are only
going to get
longer from here on, she
has to get used to the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We should be able to get a better
picture of how
suited she is for medium
and long-distance races
this fall, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This is it! The prelude to the Kikuka Sho!
Kitasan
Black, ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look how energized Kitasan Black
is. But
will she be okay running such a
long race?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Of course she'll be fine! After
all, she's
got a trump card...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it she's Sakura Bakushin O's

apprentice. But I dunno... I'm not
positive that
she's a good fit for Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! How can such baseless
rumors about
me be spreading like this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're not exactly baseless... Still...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer? Maybe I'm not cut out for
long
races after all...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, but didn't you say you weren't sure
if I can
handle them not too long ago?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't make any guarantees, but as her
trainer, I give her my honest opinion. I
saw firsthand how
much progress she
made this summer.
choice_data_list: Even so, it'll probably be fine.
Even so, it'll probably be okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her musculature, her form, her footwork.
When it comes to distance running, all
of those aspects fit
the bill. Not to
mention...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black has the heart to endure
these longer races. Right now, I'm more
expectant of
her success than concerned
about her failure.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Do you really think I'll be okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Even if it wasn't fine, I was
prepared to
not let it get to me, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Since you're so sure of me, then I have
nothing to
be scared of!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch me, Trainer. I'm not
going to trip
on my first step into fall. I
absolutely won't...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Not when Brusquement is getting
stronger and
waiting for me! I'll run like
the wind to victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Lying in wait for us is a
racing
prodigy whom Air Groove
personally mentored
and trained.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This race will add another peak to our
mountain of hard work, which we will use
as a stepping
stone to become even
stronger.
